title: NoSkillSquad Modpack
description: Explore, build, and relax — a lightweight Fabric experience built for long-term worlds.
body:
A balanced mix of exploration, building, and performance — designed for players who just want to enjoy Minecraft in a smooth and creative way.
The pack combines light adventure content, decorative additions, and performance mods to create a world that feels alive without overwhelming you.

🌍 What’s inside

Expanded world generation with new biomes, structures, and seasonal changes.

Decorative mods like Macaw’s series, More Variants, and furniture expansions for creative building.

QoL and optimization mods (C2ME, Distant Horizons, Iris Shaders, Sodium, etc.) for a stable and fluid experience.

Fully compatible with both singleplayer and future multiplayer environments.

🤝 Multiplayer

A dedicated multiplayer project will be available later.
Until then, the pack can be enjoyed solo or with friends on private servers.

⚙️ Technical details

Minecraft Version: 1.21.10

Loader: Fabric

Regular updates keep the pack stable and consistent with newer mod versions.

📝 Credits

All rights, assets, and content belong to their respective mod creators.
This modpack only combines their work into a cohesive experience for easier access and multiplayer compatibility.
